mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 3.5% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates on equity cash flows, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS > 3.5%, or the mean 20d return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.0% signals tightening labor market conditions that increase wage pressures and inflation expectations, prompting the Fed to maintain restrictive policy and suppress equity valuations, resulting in negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 40% of instances when UNRATE < 5.0%, or the mean 20d return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in residential construction permits above 2.1 million units signals strong housing demand and a broad-based economic expansion, which boosts consumer confidence and corporate earnings expectations, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 40% of instances when HOUST > 2100.0, or the mean 60d return in triggered periods is not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in industrial production below 106.0 index points signals weakening manufacturing activity and a contraction in the real economy, which reduces corporate profitability and triggers risk-off sentiment, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in less than 40% of instances when INDPRO < 106.0, or the mean 5d return in triggered periods is not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in both real personal consumption expenditures (via GDP) and residential investment (via HOUST) signals a broad-based demand surge that strengthens corporate revenue visibility and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the interaction effect is not statistically significant (interaction term p > 0.05 in regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and CPI inflation above 198.0 signals a persistent inflationary environment that forces the Fed to maintain restrictive policy, increasing real interest rates and reducing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when both FEDFUNDS > 3.5% and CPIAUCSL > 198.0, or the joint signal has a Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in unemployment rate and rise in non-farm payrolls above 134,000 signals a labor market that is both tightening and expanding, increasing wage pressures and inflation expectations, which triggers a hawkish Fed response and suppresses equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
regime_hint: tight labor market with strong hiring
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when both UNRATE < 5.0% and PAYEMS > 134000, or the interaction term in a regression model is not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) combined with rising residential investment (HOUST) signals a durable demand expansion that supports corporate earnings and reduces recession risk, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in less than 60% of instances when both GDPC1 and HOUST are rising, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in regression model).
